content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Des Moines

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and hours spent leading or directing projects. PMI sets specific thresholds; Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend sessions on your schedule while earning the formal education hours PMI requires. Our Des Moines-based instructors deliver real-world examples and interactive instruction tailored to working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application with the Project Management Institute and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and required documentation. Once PMI approves your eligibility, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam at a Pearson Vue testing center in the Des Moines area. Test-takers typically prepare for several weeks; our support accelerates readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Stay current through training, volunteer work, and professional engagement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning resources to help you maintain and advance your credential.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
